submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 1.65 mm gap achieves the best time resolution (1.28 ns) among all environmentally compliant options. While Mixture-G1 offers superior performance (0.921 ns at 2.5 mm gap), it fails environmental compliance requirements (compliance=0), making it unsuitable for the laboratory's policies. Mixture-G2, though compliant, delivers significantly worse time resolution (2.061 ns at best). Through optimization, Mixture-G3 at 1.65 mm gap represents the optimal balance: it is fully environmentally compliant (compliance=1), achieves 38% better time resolution than the best G2 configuration, and falls well within the 1-3 mm gap constraint. This configuration maximizes detector performance while satisfying all safety and environmental requirements.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Among environmentally compliant options, Mixture-G3 at 1.65 mm achieves 1.28 ns resolution, which is the best compliant result. This is 38% better than Mixture-G2's best performance of 2.061 ns.

requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the three candidate mixtures (G1, G2, G3) specified in the task.

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 has environmental compliance = 1 (fully compliant), unlike Mixture-G1 which has compliance = 0.
The recommended gap of 1.65 mm falls within the required range of 1-3 mm.
